title: JwkSet
description: The JSON Web Key Set served at the JWKS URI, derived from identity_oidc::jwt::JwkSet. At least one key, always: an empty JWKS is a provider that cannot verify anything it has ever signed, which during a rotation window is indistinguishable from a total outage. A client that sees an empty set must treat it as an outage, not as "nothing to check here".
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; the JWKS endpoint is DEFERRED to phase 4 (OIDC provider) and no key exists to publish

x-note-on-min-items.rule: the set may not be empty
x-note-on-min-items.source: identity_oidc::jwt::JwkSet documents the invariant; the Rust type is a plain Vec and does not enforce it at construction
x-note-on-min-items.consequence: a consumer that receives {"keys": []} is looking at a broken provider and must fail closed
